results.what: Pencil sketches of apparatus-like figures: a circle with crossed rotating bars and an attached rod, rectangles, and a profile drawing with curves; no mathematical content.

deep.surprise_reason: The page contains only uninterpreted pencil sketches with no formulas or text. Nothing here could be compared with or credited against the mathematical literature.
transcription_corrections: Transcription is essentially correct. The folio number '56' is the only writing; there are no formulas or words.

Additional description: the sheet is folded horizontally at mid-height and the upper half is blank. In the central sketch the inner figure is two crossed bars with small contact- or clamp-like strokes, plus diagonal lines with tick marks on the circle rim. The lower drawing includes a sagging curve between hatched supports and a tall vertical rectangle with curves sweeping to its base. A small faint mark near the bottom centre is possibly a stray stroke.
